_deck_note: ONE DECK PER SEAT, and the picks are NOT free: they come from the fixture table in .claude/agents/README.md, which reasons about each one. precon-party-time is the arbitrary-pasted-deck path plus the bad-deck case (cohesion 0.11); inalla is tuned, so a false alarm is the strong signal, and it serves BOTH the tuner and the phone seat so modality is the only variable between them; sarevok-lord-of-pain is seeded with claims the owner hand-judged FALSE and is the instrument's own calibration. RE-VERIFY THE SEEDING BEFORE EVERY ROUND -- on 2026-09-18 the two claims the README named were gone from a live analysis and two different FALSE ones had survived in their place.
_goal_note: Every goal below is phrased the way a PLAYER would say it, never in this tool's vocabulary. A goal written as 'inspect the breadth axis' tests nothing, because it hands the persona the word we are trying to find out whether they know. That is the whole knowledge-ceiling axis, and it is the only axis that has ever produced a persona-specific finding here.

steps.goal: work out what this deck is trying to do, without reading anything twice
decide whether this deck is any good
see what each of my cards is actually doing for the deck
find out whether my mana can actually cast this stuff, and which colour is worst
check whether I have enough removal and enough ramp
find out what is wrong with the deck and what to change
see which cards actually work with each other
find my commander in the picture and see what it is connected to
steps._note: {{commander}} resolves per deck from the decklist. Round 1 hard-coded a card from a deck that had since been swapped out, so all three seats searched for something genuinely absent and reviewed the empty state by accident.

steps.goal: get a shortlist of cards worth cutting
check whether this deck can do something degenerate I did not know about

_steps_note: THE SIX CHAPTERS ARE SEPARATE STEPS. Round 1 had one `land` step blind-scrolling the report, and 3 of 4 seats reported the same thing: 'the report is cropped, I never saw MANA, ROLES or FIX'. The rail is buttons at desktop and a native <select> below 1023px, so each chapter step uses `any` to reach it whichever way this width offers -- a failure is recorded only if BOTH fail, which keeps the act log meaningful. Round 1 also had `land` and `judge` byte-identical (same path, no acts) and 3/4 seats said so.
